name: search-preview
description: Preview files while searching, telescope style

commands.title: Search Preview: Quick Open with Preview
Search Preview: Show All Editors by Most Recently Used with Preview

searchPreview.search.fdPath.description: Path to the fd executable. Use 'fd' if it's in your PATH, or provide full path.

searchPreview.search.fdOptions.description: Additional command line options to pass to fd

searchPreview.search.excludeDirectories.description: Directories to exclude from search results

searchPreview.search.excludePatterns.description: File patterns to exclude from search results (glob patterns)

searchPreview.search.maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results to display

searchPreview.search.timeout.description: Timeout for fd search operations in milliseconds

searchPreview.search.enableJsonOutput.description: Enable JSON output from fd for better parsing (requires fd 8.0+)

searchPreview.search.cacheTimeout.description: File list cache timeout in milliseconds (telescope-style caching)

searchPreview.search.enableFileWatcher.description: Enable file system watcher to invalidate cache when files change

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
